steps.en: Install it next to Selenium 4, a browser and its webdriver on PATH
steps.zh: 装上它，配好 Selenium 4、浏览器和 webdriver

steps.en: Swap one import; the rest of your Selenium code stays as it is
steps.zh: 只换一行 import，其余 Selenium 代码原样不动

steps.en: Routes the browser through its own MITM proxy and has it accept its root certificate
steps.zh: 让浏览器走它自带的中间人代理，并放行它的根证书

steps.en: Drive the browser exactly as before
Decrypts and stores every request and response the page makes, running your interceptors
steps.zh: 解密并记下页面发出的每个请求和响应，顺带跑你设的拦截函数

steps.en: Read the captured traffic: URL, status, headers, body
steps.zh: 读抓到的流量：网址、状态码、请求头、正文

value.en: The background API calls and headers behind a Selenium page, without leaving Selenium — on a library frozen since 2024
value.zh: 不离开 Selenium 就能看到页面背后的接口调用和请求头——只是这个库 2024 年起已冻结

sources: https://github.com/wkeeling/selenium-wire#readme (no longer maintained notice; Installation: pip install selenium-wire; Browser Setup: webdriver on PATH)
https://github.com/wkeeling/selenium-wire#certificates (own root certificate; browser told to add it as an exception)
